PLAN "12-Week Couch-to-5K (EIA-Safe) Plan"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary endurance:
    name "Complete a 5K in 12 weeks with safe EIA management"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation & Tolerance" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Intro Walk-Run Intervals A":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk_run_intervals 6x1..2 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Intro Walk-Run Intervals B":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk_run_intervals 6x1..2 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
      DAY Saturday training 35m "Intro Walk-Run Intervals C":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk_run_intervals 6x1..2 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 38m "Walk-Run Progression A":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk_run_intervals 6x2..3 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
      DAY Wednesday training 38m "Walk-Run Progression B":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk_run_intervals 6x2..3 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
      DAY Saturday training 38m "Walk-Run Progression C":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk_run_intervals 6x2..3 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Run-Biased Intervals A":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk_run_intervals 5x3..4 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Run-Biased Intervals B":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk_run_intervals 5x3..4 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
      DAY Saturday training 42m "Run-Biased Intervals C":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          walk_run_intervals 5x3..4 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 42m "Steady Introduction A":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk_blocks 5x4..5 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
      DAY Wednesday training 42m "Steady Introduction B":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk_blocks 5x4..5 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
      DAY Saturday training 45m "Steady Introduction C":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk_blocks 5x4..5 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
  PHASE "Build Volume & Consistency" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Extended Run-Walk A":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk_blocks 4x6..7 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Extended Run-Walk B":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk_blocks 4x6..7 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
      DAY Saturday training 48m "Extended Run-Walk C":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk_blocks 4x7..8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 46m "Continuous Effort Intro A":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          steady_run 1x12..15 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          walk_recovery 1x3..5 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          steady_run 1x8..10 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
      DAY Wednesday training 46m "Continuous Effort Intro B":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          steady_run 1x12..15 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          walk_recovery 1x3..5 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          steady_run 1x8..10 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
      DAY Saturday training 50m "Continuous Effort Intro C":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          steady_run 1x15..18 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          walk_recovery 1x3..5 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          steady_run 1x10..12 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 48m "Steady Build A":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          steady_run 1x16..20 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
      DAY Wednesday training 48m "Steady Build B":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          steady_run 1x16..20 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
      DAY Saturday training 52m "Steady Build C":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          steady_run 1x20..24 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Low-Intensity Endurance A":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          steady_run 1x18..22 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Low-Intensity Endurance B":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          steady_run 1x18..22 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
      DAY Saturday training 55m "Low-Intensity Endurance C":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          steady_run 1x24..28 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
  PHASE "5K Specific Prep" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Steady Plus Strides A":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          steady_run 1x20..24 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          relaxed_strides 6x0..0 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Steady Plus Strides B":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          steady_run 1x20..24 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          relaxed_strides 6x0..0 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
      DAY Saturday training 56m "Endurance Run C":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          steady_run 1x28..32 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 52m "Intro Tempo Segments A":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          steady_run 1x15..20 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          tempo_run 2x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
      DAY Wednesday training 52m "Intro Tempo Segments B":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          steady_run 1x15..20 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          tempo_run 2x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
      DAY Saturday training 58m "Endurance Run C":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          steady_run 1x30..34 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 50m "5K Pace Tease A":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          steady_run 1x10..15 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          5k_effort_intervals 4x3..4 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
      DAY Wednesday training 46m "Recovery Steady B":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          steady_run 1x20..24 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 12m
      DAY Saturday training 46m "Dress Rehearsal C":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          steady_run 1x20..25 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          relaxed_strides 4x0..0 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 42m "Taper Steady A":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          steady_run 1x16..20 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 12m
      DAY Wednesday training 36m "Sharpener B":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          steady_run 1x10..12 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          5k_effort_intervals 3x2..3 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
      DAY Saturday training 45m "5K Event Day":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          5k_event_run 1x1..1 rpe 7 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
